scope: Repository implementations that advertise Node profile or profile-family evidence. SDK libraries are manifest emitters and validators, not deployment IUTs.
rules: Every listed manifest carries a runnable command and enumerates its complete advertised case scope.
not_claimed manifests may use partial or unexecuted evidence states but may not omit cases from a complete-profile scope.
family_only manifests must pass every case in the advertised family and must not imply full-profile certification.
Node L2 emitted manifests must reject partial-family na and enforce the single-Anchor versus multi-Anchor applicability invariant.
